en: An illustrated view of a large fortified palace or castle complex in a park-like setting at dusk. The long façade has many rectangular windows with shutters and a crenellated section with a round tower. On top of the central tower flies a tricolour flag in vertical bands of green, white, and red. Trees and paths fill the foreground, and the sky is cloudy and dramatic, giving a romantic, painterly atmosphere.
